section_6_4_rule_comparison.decision: The earlier complete-rule contrast wording was incorrect. Table 1 isolates query allocation within a shared calibrated posterior, observation update, and final selection rule. The corrected sentence is added after the Table 1 introduction with the existing Appendix B label app:pivot-ext.
source_trace: source/core/analyze_v4.py:347-354 fits a posterior on disjoint calibration roots and calls decide on held-out roots.
source/core/analyze_v4.py:149-164 constructs the same posterior specification for each method and invokes run_selector with method-specific query behavior.
source/core/pivot_v2.py:135-144 names pivot_kg and uniform_v2 as different methods using the same posterior.
source/core/pivot_v2.py:163-179 uses knowledge-gradient per cost for pivot_kg and random available queries for uniform_v2.
source/core/pivot_v2.py:196-205 conditions on each HF observation and selects the largest posterior mean, with the incumbent available, for both methods.

source/core/analyze_v4.py:355-369 seals decisions before audit-label scoring; lines 174-179 score the selected choice as held-out ISR. Scoring final ISR does not itself imply that final selection rules differ.
section_6_4_rule_comparison.appendix_boundary: Appendix B is Extended PIVOT-KG Evaluation (main.tex label app:pivot-ext). Its Leduc component forest is from a second confirmation cohort with a repeated-query sample-size variant; it is related evidence, not a decomposition of the three Table 1 rows.
section_6_4_rule_comparison.scope_note: The HighwayEnv appendix's Uniform proxy estimate statement concerns the original and fresh-seed replication cohorts. The positive eight-candidate redesign instead reconstructs the same GaussianPosterior, observes each Uniform subset, and selects with the shared posterior rule (source/highway_redesign/source/experiments/revision/highway_b4_redesign.py:93-135). These cohort details are separate from the Table 1 code trace.

registered_term.decision: Changed Registered allocation interactions to Designated allocation interactions.
evidence: core/leduc/confirm/protocol.json and core/kuhn/confirm/protocol.json have status FROZEN, primary methods pivot_kg/uniform_v2, and H3 long-minus-short interaction contrasts.
source/core/freeze_confirm.py:19-51 defines a pre-confirmation freeze workflow but is specific to the Melting Pot cohort.
The packaged Leduc and Kuhn frozen protocol JSON files have no frozen_at_utc field or independently verifiable pre-test timestamp. No external registration record was found in the inspected package.
registered_term.claim_boundary: The internal protocols designate these contrasts; the paper does not claim public registration or independently verified temporal preregistration for the first-cohort interaction.
